name: Neha Bhandarkar

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Neha Bhandarkar is a poet, author and translator who writes in Marathi, Hindi and English. Her contributor biography in Our Poetry Archive identifies her with Nagpur and describes her work as a Marathi newspaper columnist. The Guntur International Poetry Festival lists her book Hues of Fusion among its festival releases.

Her Kabita Live poem ‘Anger’ addresses its subject as an unwelcome visitor. A direct, almost nursery-rhyme opening develops into images of fire, damage and the scars left by destructive feeling. The address moves from the individual mind towards the wider violence of war, ending in a blunt demand that anger leave.
